definitions.explanation: An eight-legged creature with large pincers and a curved tail that carries a venomous sting. Found mainly in hot, dry regions; in Japan only small species live in the far south. Written in katakana, or {蠍|さそり} in kanji.

examples.japanese: サソリ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刺|さ}された→刺す：02111_sasu⟧。
examples.english: I was stung by a scorpion.
There are many scorpions in the desert.

examples.japanese: サソリ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{尾|お}→尾：01898_o⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{毒針|どくばり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていて→持つ：00478_motsu⟧、⟦{獲物|えもの}→獲物：08638_emono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺|さ}して→刺す：02111_sasu⟧⟦{弱|よわ}らせる→弱る：02439_yowaru⟧。
examples.english: A scorpion has a venomous sting at the tip of its tail and stings its prey to weaken it.

notes:
Also the name of the constellation Scorpius, ⟦{蠍座|さそりざ}→蠍座：29560_sasoriza⟧, and of the star sign Scorpio.

- サソリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧: scorpion venom
- さそり⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧: Scorpius; Scorpio (the star sign)
